title: SeoQuake: Seo User Friendly Tools, a Firefox Extension
content_raw:
Updated October 30, 2026

I wrote this in 2011, when SeoQuake was a Firefox toolbar. If you searched for SeoQuake for Firefox or Mozilla, here's where it stands now.

Semrush owns SeoQuake, and only the Chrome version is maintained. Semrush rebuilt it for Chrome in September 2026, and the Chrome Web Store has version 4.3.0 as I write this. The Firefox add-on is still on 3.9.9 from December 2022. Semrush's relaunch post says Firefox isn't part of the new version and gives no timeline. If it misbehaves in Firefox, that's the first thing I'd suspect. Internet Explorer is out of the picture too: Microsoft ended support for it in June 2022.

Most of the numbers I listed below are gone. Google dropped toolbar PageRank in 2016, DMOZ closed in March 2017, Alexa shut down in May 2022, and Google removed its cache links in 2024. Compete, Delicious and Technorati went the same way.

I don't use SeoQuake anymore. For my own sites I use Google Search Console and Ahrefs Webmaster Tools. Search Console shows the queries people find me with, the clicks and where each page ranks. Ahrefs Webmaster Tools is free once you verify your site, and it gives me a site audit and the backlinks pointing at it.

If you still want SeoQuake, install it in Chrome.

SeoQuake is a Firefox extension that allows you to view statistics of search engine parameters on the fly. SeoQuake for Mozilla Firefox consists of three functional parts: SeoToolbar (requested parameters are shown in a separate toolbar in the browser), Seobar (requested parameters are shown in a separate, fully customizable CSS/HTML block), and output of requested parameters on Search Engine Result Pages (SERPs).

SeoQuake helps a lot with SEO analysis of any website. It shows me Google PR, Google last cache, some search engine indexes (Google, Yahoo, Bing, Baidu, and Yandex), Alexa rank, Compete rank, Semrush rank, DMoz index, delicious index, Digg index, Technorati index, domain age, keyword density, and many more.
